description: Find real businesses near a place, sorted by distance (nearest of those examined; dense areas are narrowed, see result.search). Data: OpenStreetMap (ODbL, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, attributed per result); phone, website, hours only when mapped. Coverage varies; community-mapped, NOT verified by us; source=openstreetmap rows cannot be booked. Plus supply-network rows. If OSM is down: retriable 'temporarily unavailable', never invented rows. [free, no key]

availability_window.description: Accepted but NOT APPLIED - it does not narrow results. We do not hold live…

capability.description: Kind of business, e.g. 'haircut', 'plumber', 'dentist'. Mapped to OSM tags.

city.description: Alternative to location: a top-level city, normalised into…

location.description: City/town or ZIP, optionally with country ('Nizwa, Oman'). Geocoded by OSM.

radius_miles.description: Radius in miles (default 3.1, max 25); applies to OpenStreetMap results only.

zip_or_city.description: City, town, address or postal code, optionally with the country, e.g. 'Nizwa, Oman'. A bare 5-digit ZIP is read as a US ZIP; give any non-US postal code with its country (e.g. '10115, Germany').

price_band.description: Supply-network rows only; OpenStreetMap has no prices.

region.description: Alternative to location: a top-level state/region, normalised into…

name: find_business
